name: Fireflies
source:
Fireflies is a visual novel with a long term story, where you will find some shipings from GenshinImpact game,  having the opportunity to interact with them on a story.

[From [url=https://cheesecakewpizza.itch.io/fireflies-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Fireflies是一部具有长期故事的视觉小说，你会在其中找到一些来自GenshinImpact游戏的船只，并有机会与它们在故事中互动。

[来自[url=https://cheesecakewpizza.itch.io/fireflies-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
